limitations: The claim concerns the specification's terminal matching rule, not arbitrary string comparisons, identifier equivalence, or editor behavior.

statement: The specified Visual Basic for .NET grammar matches terminals without regard to case and permits full-width equivalents on a whole-token basis. A terminal token containing mixed half-width and full-width characters does not match by this rule.
